text:
maria: heads-up — discovered a regression in the Python quickstart async sample when running under uvicorn + multiple workers :bug:

maria: reproduction: the example uses `async with AsyncClient(api_key=...)` from the quickstart and it raises at startup with `AttributeError: __aenter__` on our sample app. 404 on the docs link too (the async anchor seems moved). :eyes:

jake: can you paste the snippet you ran?

maria: sure — exact copy from docs:

```py
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']) as client:
        resp = await client.generate("Say hi")
        print(resp.text)
```

maria: stacktrace (short):
```
AttributeError: 'AsyncClient' object has no attribute '__aenter__'
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/uvicorn/protocols/http/h11_impl.py", line 429, in run_asgi
    await app( scope, receive, send )
```

jake: ah — looks like the sample assumes AsyncClient implements async context manager, but our current SDK only has `aclose()` and `__aenter__/__aexit__` were added in a later patch. Docs probably got updated out of sync.

samir: also noticed the quickstart link `https://docs.redwood.ai/python/quickstart#async` 404s for me — anchor changed to `#async-client` in new site build.

maria: yeah — two issues: (1) snippet uses `async with` but the SDK version pinned in the sample (0.7.1) doesn't support it; (2) docs link mismatch. People following quickstart hit 401s/retries in containers because they attempt to re-use the client incorrectly across workers.

jake: possible quick fixes:
- update docs to show the backwards-compatible pattern (works on older SDKs):
```py
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
try:
    resp = await client.generate("hi")
finally:
    await client.aclose()
```
- or update the sample to `AsyncClient` >= 0.8 and note it supports `async with`
- add a note about auth vs retry: 401s are terminal and shouldn't be retried by default (we retry only 5xx).

samir: +1. Also request: can we add typing stub for `__aenter__`/`__aexit__` on AsyncClient so mypy/pyright catches usage mismatch earlier?

maria: filing request for: docs fix (anchor + snippet), release note about context manager support, and typing addition. Also need to clarify retry behavior in quickstart (explicit: we don't auto-retry 401).

docs-bot: created issue #1129 on docs repo: "python quickstart: async sample context manager mismatch + broken anchor" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1129

ci-bot: added label `area:docs`, `severity:medium`, `needs-backport` to issue #1129

jake: assigning to @docs for quick patch. I'll open a small PR with the two alternative snippets (old and new) and a comment about retry semantics.

samir: small patch suggestion for retry example (for users implementing custom retry):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient, RetryPolicy
policy = RetryPolicy(retry_on=[500,502], max_attempts=3)
client = AsyncClient(api_key=..., retry_policy=policy)
```

maria: perfect. thanks — can we also add a short note in onboarding about pinning SDK versions for sample reproducibility? many folks hit this when following tutorials in CI.

jake: yes — tiny checklist item for quickstart: `pip install "redwood==0.8.*"` or mention feature gates. I'll include that in the PR.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2134 (w/ snippet and anchor fix).

maria: closing loop — once PR merges, i'll run the sample in our internal onboarding runner and confirm no auth/retry surprises. :thumbsup:
